name: Word of Serious Healing, Mass
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level cleric/oracle 7, druid 8, shaman 7, witch 8

This spell functions like mass word of light healing except that it heals 3d4 + 1 per two caster levels to all creatures (maximum +17).
